subject: general
question: Select the correct combination of famous palaces and their locations in Rajasthan.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lalgarh Palace – Bikaner**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Lalgarh Palace** is located in the city of **Bikaner** in Rajasthan.
 
• The palace was built between 1902 and 1926 for Maharaja Ganga Singh.
 
• It was designed by the British architect Sir Samuel Swinton Jacob.
 
• The palace exhibits a perfect amalgamation of Rajput, Mughal, and European architectural styles.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rambagh Palace**

 
 
• Located in Jaipur, it is one of the most famous palaces in Rajasthan.
 
• It was originally built in 1835 and was used as a royal guesthouse and hunting lodge.
 
• It was later converted into a palace and is now a luxury hotel.
 
 
 
• **Umaid Bhawan Palace**
 
 
• Located in Jodhpur, it is one of the world's largest private residences.
 
• The palace was completed in 1943 and is named after Maharaja Umaid Singh.
 
• It is divided into a luxury hotel, a museum, and the residence of the royal family.
 
 
 
• **Taj Lake Palace**
 
 
• Located in Udaipur, it is a luxury hotel situated on Lake Pichola.
 
• The palace was built in 1746 under the direction of Maharana Jagat Singh II.
 
• It is famous for its stunning architecture and picturesque location.
